sections.title: The goal
sections.body: Each round gives you four letters. Find an English word containing those letters to earn as many points as possible. Their order and the letters between them affect your score.

sections.title: Accepted words
sections.body: Words must be in the English game dictionary. It includes many inflected forms and both British and American spellings. Only words of at least two letters are accepted; spaces, hyphens and apostrophes are excluded. A rejected word does not use an attempt.

sections.title: Scoring
sections.formula: score = (draw letters used × 3) + order bonus − insertions

items.label: Draw letter used
items.description: Each draw letter used in your word earns three points. Duplicate letters in the draw count separately.

items.label: Order bonus
items.description: If the used draw letters appear in the same order as in the draw, you earn three extra points.

items.label: Insertion
items.description: Each extra letter between the first and last matched draw letters costs one point. Letters outside this span do not affect the score.

sections.title: Letter colours
sections.body: After each attempt, colours show how your word was scored:

colors.label: Underlined orange
colors.description: A draw letter in the correct order: earns points and contributes to the order bonus.

colors.label: Underlined muted orange
colors.description: A draw letter used out of order: earns points without the order bonus.

colors.label: Beige
colors.description: An extra letter inside the matched span: costs one point.

colors.label: Grey
colors.description: A letter outside the matched span: does not affect the score.

modes.name: Daily challenge
modes.description: The same draw for everyone on the English site, refreshed at midnight in Paris (Europe/Paris). You have three attempts. After each attempt, you see the best possible score, but not the answer. Your English streak is separate from your French streak.

modes.name: Practice
modes.description: Unlimited random draws. After submitting a word, reveal the three highest-scoring answers to explore strategies.
